[लिख्-अच् लस्य रः] 
__1 A line, streak; मदरेखा, दानरेखा, रागरेखा &c. 
__2 The measure of a line, small portion, as much as a line; न रेखामात्रमपि व्यतीयुः [[

.]] 
__3 A row, range, line, series; मुदाश्रु मोक्ष्यसे क्षिप्रं मेघरेखेव वार्षिकी [[

.]] 
__4 Delineation, sketch, drawing; लावण्यरेखया किंचिदन्वितम् [[Ś. 6. 13.]] 
__5 The first or prime meridian of the Indian astronomers drawn from Laṅkā to Meru and passing through Ujjayinī. 
__6 Fulness, satisfaction. 
__7 Deceit, fraud. 
__8 A straight position of all limbs in dancing. 
-Comp. 
-अंशः a degree of longitude. 
-अन्तरम् distance east or west from the first meridian, longitude of a place. 
-आकार a. lineal, formed in lines, striped. 
-गणितम् geometry. 
-न्यासः the marking down of lines. 
-मात्रम् ind. even by a line.

Den. Ā. 
__1 To praise, flatter. 
__2 To vex, annoy, exasperate.
